newsitem.title: CANADA: Dundee Realty buys Carma's Regina operations.
newsitem.headline: Dundee Realty buys Carma's Regina operations.

text.p: Dundee Realty Corp on Tuesday said its Preston Developments Inc unit purchased the Regina, Saskatchewan operations of Carma Corp for C$11.5 million (US$8.25 million).

Dundee said the aquisition includes Carma's existing lot inventory, homes under construction, accounts receivable and about 725 acres of land for future development. The purchase price consists of cash and the assumption of liabilities at the closing of the transaction.
The Toronto-based company said the addition of the Regina operation to Preston's existing Saskatoon operation has made it the dominant developer in Saskatchewan.
Share of Dundee traded unchanged at 4.20 in late afternoon trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. More than 52,000 shares had changed hands.
